newsitem.title: USA: GE unit to buy shares of IBM unit.
newsitem.headline: GE unit to buy shares of IBM unit.

text.p: General Electric Co said Monday its GE Capital Information Technology Solutions unit has signed a deal to buy the shares of IVIX Sistemas Abertos de Informatica, a Brazilian unit of International Business Machines Corp.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed, it said.
IVIX is a reseller and integrator of IBM RS/6000 Unix operating systems and had 1996 sales of more than $100 million, the company said.
IVIX wil continue to operate independently but will change its name to GE Capital IT Solutions do Brasil Ltda, GE said.

In a statement, GE Capital IT Solutions president of worldwide operations Jerry Poch said: "With the acquisition of IVIX, GE Capital IT Solutions enters a key Latin American growth market and gains an established presence in Brazil, along with a strong UNIX business."
